intro.title: Calculator Introduction
intro.description: Know exactly what your taxi ride will cost before you get in. This calculator covers all three Hong Kong taxi types with automatic route calculation, tunnel fees, luggage charges, and surcharges for the most accurate fare estimate possible.

usage.title: How to Use This Calculator?
steps: Select Locations: Choose your starting point and destination, or let the calculator detect your current location automatically.
Calculate Route: The system will automatically calculate the driving distance and estimated travel time between your selected locations.
Choose Taxi Type: Select between Urban (Red), New Territories (Green), or Lantau (Blue) taxis based on your route.
Add Additional Fees: Include tunnel fees, luggage charges, and other applicable surcharges for a complete fare calculation.

questions.question: How is this different from other taxi fare calculators?
questions.answer: Most taxi fare calculators make you guess the distance yourself. This one detects your location with GPS and calculates the exact driving distance automatically. Just pick your start and destination — you get an accurate fare instantly, no guesswork needed.

questions.question: How accurate is the Hong Kong taxi fare calculator?
questions.answer: The calculator uses official Transport Department rates and real-time route calculation to provide highly accurate fare estimates. It includes all surcharges, tunnel fees, and luggage charges based on current Hong Kong taxi regulations.

questions.question: What types of Hong Kong taxis are supported?
questions.answer: The calculator supports all three types of Hong Kong taxis: Urban (Red) taxis, New Territories (Green) taxis, and Lantau (Blue) taxis, each with their specific fare structures and route restrictions.

questions.question: Does the calculator include tunnel fees and surcharges?
questions.answer: Yes, the calculator includes all major tunnel fees (Cross Harbour, Eastern Harbour, Western Harbour, and others), luggage charges, and return toll fees. It can auto-detect cross-harbour routes and suggest appropriate tunnel fees.

questions.question: Can I use my current location for fare calculation?
questions.answer: Yes, the calculator can automatically detect your current GPS location and use it as the starting point. It integrates with Hong Kong government location data for accurate address mapping.

questions.question: Is the taxi fare calculator available in Chinese?
questions.answer: Yes, the calculator is fully bilingual with support for both English and Traditional Chinese, including localized address search and fare breakdown displays.
